source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Start here by [creating an issue in the 'Testing & Reporting' Spreadsheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1d0S9k936q3tS9F0pQfe_dCj-Y8qHYgW_ftO1r_4x2J0/edit#gid=769254031) for the failed test.
3. In that new issue, include the following and ensure you can see this information in the Record:
    * Location (eg Office)
    * Maker's ID, Catalogue Number (eg Socket Outlet Number)
    * Photo of the tester showing a fail result
4. Ask someone who has been trained to create a new Electrical Appliance Asset and link it to the failed record.
  a. This is [an example asset creation flow](https://docs.google.com/
